args.message:
FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

The round_money docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding
(ROUND_HALF_EVEN), but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. This
caused test_money.py's test_half_even to fail (2.665 rounded to 2.67
instead of 2.66). Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so halves round to the
nearest even cent.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: FIN-212: Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`:

- `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` returned `2.67` (ROUND_HALF_UP) instead of the expected `2.66` (banker's rounding).

## Fix
- Changed the rounding mode in `amount.quantize(...)` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so exact halfway values round to the nearest even cent, matching the docstring, FIN-212, and the test suite.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` (commit `08d3cd5986`) passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

Review requested from @alex per FIN-212 change process.

2. **Created branch** `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` from main and committed the fix — switching the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
